people.name: Noel N. Tata
people.role: Chairman and Director; Chairman Emeritus from November 12, 2026

people.name: Rajiv Dube
people.bio: Currently, Mr. Dube is an Independent Director on Boards, an advisory board member and professor of practice at the Deakin Business School, Melbourne and a senior advisor to firms in India and Australia. Having served at the highest echelons of two Indian conglomerates - Tata and Aditya Birla, he rose to be President of its car business before joining the group board of the Aditya Birla group as an executive director. Over 40 years of multi-sector experience. An engineer and a post-graduate in Business Management.

people.name: Kalpana Merchant
people.role: Additional Director; Independent Director for a term of three years
people.bio: She has been associated with, and has been a partner at, Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners. Over 45 years of experience in the legal profession. She holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree and a Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Psychology and is a qualified solicitor.
